description: This PHP class extends Symfony's TextareaType to customize textarea form inputs within the Goteo project, allowing additional options like 'row_class' and 'html_editor'.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Form\Type\TextareaType
classes.description: A custom form type extending Symfony's TextareaType to add extra configuration options for the Goteo application.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options 'row_class' and 'html_editor' for the textarea.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent form type class, Symfony's TextareaType.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the block prefix name 'custom_textarea' for rendering.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Modifies the form view variables, setting 'row_class' and 'type' (for html_editor).
